dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple closed-loop 'O' and 'C' shaped structures visible along the mid-dorsal and lateral regions; perimeters show high-contrast dark margins with irregular, jagged geometry transitioning sharply to lighter interior rings and dark centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, solid low-intensity pixels localized on the neck region; high-intensity clusters observed at the distal end of the pectoral flipper corresponding to claw-like structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent dorsal annuli form an elongated scalene triangle oriented parallel to the spinal column, with an obtuse angle at the central node.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of four distinct, high-intensity linear points arranged in a row on the pectoral flipper, exhibiting high contrast against the surrounding dark fur.
